The decisive mistake was made by **WebServing_Expert at step 3**. It asserted that the image was first added in the October 2, 2019 revision, but its page fetches in steps 1 and 2 were truncated and showed no image or edit history. Nothing it retrieved supported that date, so the claim was unsupported from the start. Validation_Expert then planned around that date instead of checking it independently. The later code failures and the 2024 result (which is also not the correct answer, 19/02/2009) came after the wrong premise was already in place.
